tokens.note: Deliberately monochrome 'glitch'/editorial identity. primary = border/CTA ink black (#050505 on recruit, #000000 on corporate); body text never pure black — settles on #333333. No saturated accent hue anywhere; emphasis comes from black-on-white inversion + sharp 0px corners + heavy 1–2px black borders. Surfaces are white #ffffff and grey #eeeeee.
